camel_example: aliyun cr CreateArtifactLifecycleRule --region cn-hangzhou --Auto false --EnableDeleteTag true --NamespaceName 'dev-backend' --RetentionTagCount 30 --ScheduleTime WEEK --Scope INSTANCE --InstanceId 'cri-gbwfk7qbgrxe0000' --TagRegexp 'release-.0' --RepoName test_1 --DryRun true --EnableDeleteUntaggedManifest false
description_en: Creates a lifecycle management rule for artifacts
description_zh: 创建制品生命周期管理规则
kebab_example: aliyun cr create-artifact-lifecycle-rule --instance-id cri-gbwfk7qbgrxe0000 --auto false --schedule-time WEEK --namespace-name dev-backend --repo-name test_1 --tag-regexp release-.0 --retention-tag-count 30 --enable-delete-tag true --scope INSTANCE --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateArtifactLifecycleRule

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically execute the rule
parameters.name: auto

parameters.help_en: The regular expression used to match image versions to retain
parameters.help_zh: 保留镜像版本的正则表达式
parameters.name: tag_regexp

parameters.help_en: The number of images to retain
parameters.name: retention_tag_count

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable lifecycle management.

Only one of this parameter and EnableDeleteUntaggedManifest can be set to true
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启生命周期管理。

该参数与 EnableDeleteUntaggedManifest 只有一个能设置为 true
parameters.name: enable_delete_tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable artifact cleanup.

Only one of this parameter and EnableDeleteTag can be set to true
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启制品清理。

该参数与 EnableDeleteTag 只有一个能设置为 true
parameters.name: enable_delete_untagged_manifest

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable DryRun mode. If DryRun mode is enabled, only the lifecycle task scan is performed and no actual data cleanup is executed. This mode is disabled by default
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启 DryRun 模式。开启 DryRun 模式后仅执行生命周期任务扫描，不执行真实数据清理。默认关闭
parameters.name: dry_run

调用是否成功，取值：

`true`：调用成功
